name: math-kit
title: Math kit
description: Exact fractions, number formatting, small vector and 2×2 helpers, bracketed matrices and roomier math spacing for widget scripts.

letterSpacing.description: Extra letter spacing for .m, .mblock, .eq and .mat (any CSS length, or "normal" to turn it off).

wordSpacing.description: Extra word spacing for .m, .mblock, .eq and .mat (any CSS length, or "normal").

blockLineHeight.description: Line height of .mblock display math (CSS line-height value).

matrixGap.description: Row and column gap between matrix entries (CSS gap value).

bracket.description: Default bracket style for every matrix, hand-written or drawn by Study.math.mat() and col(): "square", "round", "bar" (determinant bars), "soft" (rounded side bars) or "none". A matrix's own mat-* class overrides it.

unicodeMinus.description: Write negative numbers with the Unicode minus sign (−) instead of a hyphen.

infinity.description: Text Study.math.fmt() returns for an infinite value (negative infinity gets a minus in front).

strict.description: true: fractions throw a RangeError on a zero denominator, division by zero or values past 2^53. false: no exceptions, like typical hand-rolled helpers (a zero denominator gives d = 0, gcd(0, 0) = 1).

globalAlias.description: Also expose the flat helper names (F, fadd, fmt, mat, …, plus Plane, View3D, presetButtons from the other widget packages) as window[globalAlias], for migrating old page scripts. null = off.
